package.description: An IRC client based on XChat.

en-US.description: An IRC client based on XChat.
en-US.longDescription: HexChat is an open source, feature-rich, multi-network IRC client based on XChat. It offers a wide range of features, including Python/Perl scripting, spellcheck, proxies, SASL, DCC support. With an easy to use interface, it offers a great method of chatting online.
en-US.name: HexChat

zh-CN.description: 基于 XChat 的 IRC 客户端。
zh-CN.longDescription: HexChat 是一款基于 XChat 的开源、功能丰富、多站点的 IRC 客户端，提供包括 Python/Perl 脚本、拼写检查、代理、SASL 和 DCC 支持在内的多种功能。它的界面简单易用，是在线聊天的好帮手。
